title: The Watch Losing Time
subtitle: Now let's set the watch back to the right time.

items.text: The Watch Losing Time

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ed è subito sera!
A glow cuts through the air. The mainsail halyard breaks in a snap.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Well done, Sonetto! Now cut the other halyard! We need to reduce the angle of attack and depower the ship!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Roger that!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But we can't stay like this for long. Vertin! Have you thought of anything?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's not working. I've tried different ways, but the tempest blocked every signal I sent for help.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So is that it?! We are as good as dead?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait, there might be another way.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm sorry, Ms. Radio. I need to borrow you for a second.

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: Huh?
The radio whimpers helplessly, but that voice is soon drowned in the fierce storm.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Field Mission Evacuation Instructions, Article 21 ...
There is another way, just ahead.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: "Whenever there is an emergency, the field officer may send an SOS code with their wands through any transmission device with round buttons on it."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: "Any Foundation member nearby will provide immediate humanitarian aid."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: "To send the code, please turn the knob one time to the right, half to the left, and then one time to the right."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If you succeed, you shall hear ...
"Click."
The knob is turned fully to its end point.

items.speaker: Radio
items.text: May the peace be with you.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I've never seen such a tremendous ritual.
When the light of the ritual fades, three people dressed in white show up on the deck.
They are wearing uniforms that look completely different from those of the usual investigators or Foundation staff.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: We are the special mission squad—Razor. Please show me your ID.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you so much! We are ...

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Oh, we know you, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Even in our special operation squad, you have quite a name.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: It seems you are in big trouble, huh?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We were under attack by a giant sea monster when sailing in the Gorgon Current. Please help us ashore safely!

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Haha! Right down to business. Good, good! I like a straightforward person.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Alright, William, Todd, better get a move on!
The arcane blades are incredibly sharp.
The razors pierce the monster's scales. Several snake heads are cut off and fall into the sea.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Incredible. Is that a full-size Gorgon? I've only read about this ancient sea monster in literatures.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Watch out! Its eyes will turn you into stone!

items.speaker: "Razor" soldier
items.text: There has been no witness report of a Gorgon since the 12th century. I thought the current was simply named after the mythology.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Well, it's my privilege to have the chance to fight against it, huh?

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: William, Todd! Let's see who gets it down first!

items.speaker: "Razor" soldier
items.text: "Entities should not be multiplied unnecessarily."

items.speaker: "Razor" soldier
items.text: Captain, I hope you still remember our founding motto.
A broom passes by the ship swiftly. A playful, interested smile comes to Lilya's face.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Want to compete with me in speed? Heh, have a try, if you dare.

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Ho-ho! You have guts, and I appreciate it. Bring it on!

items.speaker: "Razor" Captain
items.text: Speed up, my friends! We need to rush back to the Balkan Peninsula for another mission!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Everyone, please wait a minute!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The size of the sea monster ... It's shrinking!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Errrr, what's happening now? It's gone out of sight. I have a bad feeling about this.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Not good! It's crawling into the cabin!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It plans to tear the ship apart from the inside! Everyone, watch ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper!
Before passing out, the only thing we can hear ...
is the screaming ...
and the hands reaching out.
What ... is this place?
Blue sky, white clouds, and the beach ... a strange island.
The waves are gently washing over the body.
And someone is staring at us.
Your watch was wrong.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Pardon me?
Your watch was wrong.
She repeats, as if this is the only thing worth saying.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you talking about my pocket watch?
The numbers are now entirely different from the previous display.
Your watch was losing time, so I fixed it for you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I, I don't understand.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Do you mean this is the right time?
Yeah.
This is the year 2007, is it not?
TO BE CONTINUED…
